entry.author: Te Hiringa Mahara
entry.summary:
Te Hiringa Mahara hosted a webinar on 25 September, 2025 showcasing findings from our Crisis response recent literature.

The webinar featured panellists offering real-world examples of effective crisis response practice. They discussed how different approaches can inform crisis responses that are timely, non-coercive, culturally safe and connected to wider systems of care.

Our panellists were:
• Sonya Russell, Kaiwhakahaere Hauora Hinengaro, Waranga | Director Mental Health and Addiction Sector Leadership, Te Hiringa Mahara – Mental Health and Wellbeing Commission
• Ruth Borrett, Chief Operating Officer, Ember Korowai Takitini
• Inspector Matt Morris, Health Partnerships Team Manager, Prevention Team, NZ Police.

The session was chaired by Dr Barbara Disley, Te Hiringa Mahara board member.

Read our recent literature scan here: https://www.mhwc.govt.nz/news-and-resources/crisis-response-literature-scan-downloads/

This webinar is part of the ongoing Te Hiringa Mahara programme of work on the crisis response system.
